# Request

As a clerk I want a queue number so that patients stop crowding the desk.

Given a patient at the desk, When I issue a number, Then the wall display shows it.

Stakeholders: clerk, patient, ops manager.

Success: walk-out rate from 18% to 10%.

Out of scope: mobile app. Constraints: privacy, no full names on the wall.

Options: numbered tickets vs custom app vs do nothing.
